self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1: a Charged Attack hit grants a Bond of Life worth 25% of Max HP (once / 14s). While holding a Bond of Life, gain +12% DMG Bonus; if the Bond is >= 30% of Max HP, gain an additional +24% (36% total). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).
